vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: amateur-radio-dx
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle is benign. It connects to predefined ham radio DX cluster nodes via telnet for monitoring, saves state to `/tmp/dx-monitor-state.json`, and uses a local configuration file `dx-ai-config.json`. The `dx-ai-enhanced.py` script executes `dx-monitor.py` via `subprocess.run` with hardcoded, safe arguments. There is no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, persistence mechanisms, or prompt injection attempts against the OpenClaw agent. All network and file operations are aligned with the stated purpose of a ham radio DX monitor.
